name: Sin Hunter
detailed_description:
Find Out Us

  • BiliBili & Small Black Box & Rednote & Modian: 瞳电游工作室


Contact Us

  • Email: publish@tdgame.studio


About the Game

  • Sin Hunter is a two-dimensional fantasy style Rougelike card-building combat game. Players take on the role of a sin hunter who helps the demon managers in Hell suppress the rebellion of the Primordial Abyss and uncover the secrets of Hell's origins. Players will need to fight as they journey to the depths of the primordial abyss, and increase their power in battle to deal with the increasingly powerful gatekeepers of the abyss.

  • The unpredictable primordial abyss

  • Under the influence of mystical forces, each abyss exploration of the player is a new adventure and battle.

  • Flexible strategy system

  • Use your cards in battle to gain resources and use them to defeat demons or destroy crystal nuclei to build your arsenal of card abilities.

  • Defeat the Primordial Abyss Gatekeeper to obtain an Ancient Relic

  • The power of the Relic will help you face the Primordial Abyss Gatekeepers who grow stronger as you go deeper into the Abyss.

  • Start a conversation with a demon manager with a different personality

  • Give them gifts or complete their quests to get new powers from them. These powers will help you become more comfortable in exploring and fighting in the Primordial Abyss.

  • In the course of the conversation, you can also learn about hell and the primordial abyss.
